turns.assessment: The failure localizes to the S18→S02 booster amplifier. Its input power was unchanged, while it raised AMP_FAIL and its output disappeared; the next amplifier then reported input LOS and every downstream amplifier, channel monitor, and affected receiver lost signal. This rules strongly against the OMS input patch or first fibre span and supports a hard amplifier failure.

proposals.rationale: O1 identifies amplifier failure at the booster; O49 shows loss of its output despite no change in its input-power instrument. O2 and O43-O48 show the resulting downstream loss, which propagates through S02 and S10 to the affected channels and services, including svc354.
